verdict.rationale: Blink Shell is an iOS SSH/Mosh terminal app. A terminal could plausibly offer an official SDK or scripting API, so the axis applies, but the evidence documents none. Building the app itself from source with Xcode and running Python/Lua scripts locally are not official SDKs for building against the product, and the probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
